coords: frame pixel coords (0,0 = top-left of the frame), boss faces RIGHT; when flipX mirror x (x' = 159 - x). Frame i of the grid = row i // 12, column i % 12.

points_doc.chainHand: = gripF: start of the chain the engine draws (fx_boss_chain) when the hook is off the hand (chainhook throw/hold/yank, hookrain)
points_doc.hook: hook position while it hangs from the hand
points_doc.cleaverTip: blade tip (use the hit frame's tip for the slash hitbox / spark)
points_doc.chainEnd: end of the chain stub drawn in the sprite
points_doc.headBox: head part bbox [x0,y0,x1,y1] incl. outline - weak point / headshot box

lighting.paintedLight: 精灵只画顶部偏前的中性主光（圣经 6.1）：没有烘焙环境色、边缘光、投影；外轮廓全部是墨色 #0c0a08

rim.use: route C v2 front rim: ADD under the actor light multiply x the direct light from that side; swap L/R when flipX (same format as v02-zombies-a)

emit.content: eye whites + glowing red eyes (#c04020 / #d8d0c0) + tell glints (#e8372c eye tell, #ffffff blade glint, hook flash)
emit.use: ADD (glow pass) - night / blood moon / p3 always

normal.encoding: RGB = normal * 0.5 + 0.5, x right, y UP, z toward the camera; 8 azimuths x 3 tilts (0/30/55 deg) so N.L gives stepped bands; negate R when flipX
normal.origin: height = each rig part's own designed height (bevel radius per part + hand-placed rolls / creases), posed with the part - not estimated from the colours
normal.use: optional: Phaser Light2D normalMap, or N.L of the muzzle-flash light in the actor light map (load on demand for the boss arena)
